verdict.rationale: Expensify ships an embedded AI agent (Concierge / Ask Expensify AI), so letting users connect external MCP servers to it is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows users can register or plug in MCP servers. The API docs cover credentials and OAuth for inbound integrations only. The '/agent-device' skill in the GitHub repo is developer test tooling, not a user-facing MCP-client feature.
